Theorem
[Interior smooth density] 1. ch7:7.9\group ch07-sobolev-spaces Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0166, gilbarg-trudinger:page-0167 The subspace $C^\infty (\Omega )\cap W^{k,p}(\Omega )$ is dense in $W^{k,p}(\Omega )$.
Proof

\sketch Choose an exhaustion $\Omega _j\Subset \Omega _{j+1}$ and a subordinate partition of unity $\{ \psi _j\} $. For any $u\in W^{k,p}(\Omega )$ and $\varepsilon >0$, choose $h_j$ so that

\begin{equation} \tag {7.25} h_j\leq \dist (\Omega _j,\partial \Omega _{j+1}) \end{equation}

and $\| (\psi _ju)_{h_j}-\psi _ju\| _{W^{k,p}(\Omega )}\leq \varepsilon 2^{-j}$. The locally finite sum $v=\sum _j(\psi _ju)_{h_j}$ is smooth and satisfies $\| u-v\| _{W^{k,p}(\Omega )}\leq \varepsilon $.

□
